title: ElephantAgent: Contextual State Continuity in Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2607.01919v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic systems enhance their capabilities by invoking external tools and maintaining persistent memory. However, recent tool and memory poisoning attacks can covertly bias agent behavior. We observe that such attacks mounted out of band share a single enabler: each succeeds only by presenting the agent with a contextual state (e.g., tool state and memory) that is not the latest faithfully evolved one. This observation suggests that a continuity check over the contextual state covers this family of attacks. We present ElephantAgent, a protocol that enforces Contextual State Continuity over the bounded, security-critical subset of the agent's context. Before each planning-and-execution cycle, ElephantAgent recomputes the digest of the local contextual state and verifies it against the latest authorized digest in a linearizable ledger of state transitions, maintained over replicated trusted hardware. translated_title: ElephantAgent：智能体系统中的上下文状态连续性
translated_abstract: 智能体系统通过调用外部工具和维护持久记忆来增强其能力。然而，近期出现的工具投毒和记忆投毒攻击能够隐蔽地偏置智能体的行为。我们观察到，这类带外发起的攻击共享同一个使能条件：它们只有通过向智能体呈现一个并非最新真实演化状态的上下文状态（例如工具状态和记忆）才能成功。这一观察表明，对上下文状态的连续性检查可以覆盖这一整类攻击。我们提出了ElephantAgent，这是一个在智能体上下文中有限的、安全关键的子集上强制执行上下文状态连续性的协议。在每个规划与执行周期之前，ElephantAgent重新计算本地上下文状态的摘要，并将其与一个可线性化的状态转换账本中最新授权的摘要进行核对，该账本维护在复制的可信硬件之上。该协议还提供历史……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出ElephantAgent协议，在每个规划与执行周期前对智能体安全关键的上下文状态计算摘要，并在可信硬件维护的可线性化账本中验证其连续性，从而防御工具投毒和记忆投毒这类依赖呈现非最新状态的攻击。
en_tdlr: ElephantAgent is a protocol that defends against tool and memory poisoning attacks by enforcing contextual state continuity—recomputing and verifying the digest of the agent's security-critical context against an authorized ledger on replicated trusted hardware before each planning-and-execution cycle.
